notes:
The user asked for five countries only (Indonesia, Kenya, Morocco, North Macedonia, Philippines). This report is the Morocco one, so I extracted it in full.

Coverage: every numbered figure and table in the List of Figures and List of Tables is included: 52 figures (1-1 to 5-1) and 6 tables (2-1, 5-1 to 5-5). The three annex tables are also included (Annex 1 Table I and Table 2, and the unnumbered Annex 2 Employment Table).

How items were split:
- Multi-panel figures are split into one item per panel (a/b/c/d) when the panels show different indicators.
- Figure 2-7 is kept as one item because its panels show the same index, split only by sector (manufacturing and services).

Pages: page numbers are PDF pages. PDF page = printed page + 9 (for example, Figure 1-1 is on printed page 11, PDF page 20).
- The Overview (PDF pp. 10-18) has no figures.
- Boxes 1-1 and 4-1 contain Figures 1-3 and 4-11. Boxes 3-1, 5-1 and 5-2 are text only.
- Table 5-1 runs across PDF pp. 84-87 and has no source line.
- The annex tables have no source line either. I attributed Annex 1 to MFMod by inference.

Visual check: I viewed page images for every figure and table page (PDF pp. 20-32, 35-47, 49-61, 65-79, 84-92). I read the annex pages from the text only.

Anomalies and uncertainties:
- **Fig 1-7b:** the title says 1995-2023, but the chart shows 2012/2016/2018/2021/2024 ranks.
- **Fig 1-8b:** compares peer countries, but the printed source only cites HCP data. The source of the peer data is not stated.
- **Fig 1-11b:** the title says US$, but the y-axis label looks like it reads 'Million, MAD'. Hard to read.
- **Fig 2-12:** the source cites only the Atkin and Donaldson (2022) method. The underlying data is not stated; the note mentions survey answers on courts.
- **Fig 3-9b:** shows OECD comparator tax wedges, but the source line cites only CNSS administrative data. The comparator source is not stated.
- **Fig 4-6:** the source says 'panels a and n', which is probably a typo for 'a and b'. Panel b's title says 'index=2022', but its axis says 1 = median male formal wage.
- **Fig 4-1a:** the pyramid legend is too small to read reliably. It appears to overlay several years.
- **Caption wording:** some captions differ slightly from the List of Figures (for example, Fig 3-4 'PMRs' vs 'Product market regulations'). I recorded the in-text caption.

Classification judgments:
- 'Replicable_public' is 'no' for figures built on non-public LFS microdata, OMTPME/DGI/CNSS administrative data, or the FAT and HR surveys. It is 'partly' where HCP publishes aggregates.
- Chapter 1 'HCP data' figures are recorded as national statistics, not microdata.

This is the North Macedonia report, one of the five countries the user asked for. Coverage: Figures 1-89 and Tables 1-9 from the list of figures/tables (pp. 7-9) were all found and checked against the body text. Also included: 6 unnumbered Overview charts (pp. 12-13), 3 unnumbered recommendation tables in Chapter 6 (pp. 73-78), the Annex 5 policy-assumption table (pp. 89-94), and 3 unnumbered tables at the end (the macro standardized table, Employment Table, Productivity Table; pp. 95-97). Page numbers are PDF pages; the PDF page is the printed page plus 1. Each figure is recorded on the page where its caption sits. Figures 39-40 have captions on p.36 but their charts are on p.37. Figure 57's caption is on p.50 and its charts on p.51. Panels with different indicators are split into separate items (23, 45, 53, 56, 57, 58, 64, 66, 67, 68, 69, 71, 72, 73, 74, 76, 77, 78, 82, 85, 87). Panels that show the same indicator for different subgroups are kept as one item: Fig 27 and 28 (manufacturing/services) and Fig 65 a-d (firm size). Box 4 and Box 5 contain no figures. Boxes 1-3 contain Figures 6-7, Figures 46-47, and Table 4 with Figures 54-55, which are labelled with their box. I checked all chart pages visually: 12-13, 20-28, 30-41, 43-51, 53-58, 59-71, 73-74 and 78-86.

Inconsistencies in the report itself:
(1) The Fig 37/38 captions look swapped. Fig 37 says 'FDI stock remains strong' but its subtitle and chart show FDI inflows; Fig 38 says 'inflows are leveling' but shows FDI inward stock. I recorded indicators from the subtitles and charts.
(2) The Fig 40 subtitle reads 'FDI inward stock as share of GDP', but the chart shows FDIRI scores by restriction type.
(3) The Fig 64a panel label reads 'Exports and imports of goods and services (% of GDP), 2000-2024', but the chart shows export destination shares (EU excl. Germany, Germany, Rest of World, Western Balkans), 2008-2023.
(4) The Fig 8 subtitle says 2000-2023, but the chart shows the private capital stock for 1995-2019.
(5) The Fig 88 subtitle says 2018-2020 while its axis says 2018-2022. Fig 88 duplicates Fig 6.

notes:
Coverage: 103-page PDF. Text page numbers (form-feed count) match PDF page numbers (printed page n = PDF page n+15). I checked every page with figures by looking at the page images (PDF pp. 8-99). I also checked the front matter (Foreword, Executive Summary, Preface/Framework). It has no figures or tables. I skipped the cover and decorative images.

Captions: numbered as "Figure N" in the Overview (1-14), "Figure X.Y" in the chapters, and "Table 1-5". Box figures carry chapter numbers (Box 3: Fig 1.14; Box 4: Figs 1.20-1.21; Box 5: Figs 3.14-3.15; Box 6: Fig 3.17). Boxes 1, 2, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are text only.

Panel handling: I split panels into separate items when they show different indicators or sources (2.2a/b, 2.5a/b, 2.7a/b, 3.17a/b, 3.20a/b, 4.1a/b, 4.7a/b, 6.2a/b, 6.3a/b). I kept panels as one item when they repeat the same indicator across sectors or groups, or show close variants of one index (2.1, 2.6, 2.9, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5, 4.6, 6.1). Figure 4.8 is a single six-panel connectivity chart and is one item.

Duplicates: the Overview reuses chapter charts. Fig 3 = 1.1, Fig 4 = 1.2, Fig 5 = 3.9, Fig 6 = 3.6, Fig 7 = 1.5, Fig 8 = 1.6, Fig 9 = 1.7, Fig 10 = 1.8, Fig 11 = 2.3, Fig 12 = 1.10, Fig 13 = 1.12. All are listed separately as printed.

Source-line oddities, recorded as printed:
(a) Fig 10 cites Darvas (2012, 2021), a REER source, while the identical Fig 1.8 cites GMID. The Fig 10 source is probably a copy error.
(b) Fig 5.3 (firm adaptation practices by size) cites BLGF and the 2020 OECD-World Observatory, the same as Fig 3.19. This is probably a copy error; the real firm-survey source is unclear.
(c) Fig 4.7 has one source line (WBES) for both panels. The origin of panel b's data (education of the working-age population across East Asian countries) is not stated.
(d) GMID (Figs 1.8 and 1.9) is not defined in the report. I set data_level to unknown and replicability to unclear.
(e) Fig 2.1 cites "CPBI 2018" for a 2006-2019 series.
(f) The Fig 2.6 y-axis unit is not labeled. The text implies TFP levels (probably log).
(g) Fig 1.3's legend says "PHL LFS (15-16)", which is probably a typo for 15-64.
(h) Figs 1.1/3 are growth incidence curves sourced only to "PSA". The underlying household income survey (probably FIES) is not named.

Normalization: generic "PSA" is recorded as "PSA (NSO)"; LFS as labour force survey; ASPBI/CPBI as firm census/admin data; PSA regional accounts as national accounts (NSO). Sources with no standard name are recorded as "Other (...)". Figs 1.16-1.18 share one source line (PSA, ILO 2025, IMF 2025); I gave each panel the relevant subset.

The Standardized Tables after Chapter 6 (pp. 96-99) are unnumbered and marked chapter "Annex". This file covers only the Philippines report. The user's relayed request listed five countries (Indonesia, Kenya, Morocco, North Macedonia, Philippines), and the Philippines is among them, so the extraction went ahead.
